# Dharwin S - AI & Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Dharwin S is an AI & Data Science student and professional Full-Stack Developer specializing in React, Python, machine learning, cloud computing, and intelligent web applications.

## About

Dharwin S is a B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with hands-on experience building production-grade AI systems, full-stack web applications, and cloud-integrated platforms. He bridges the gap between complex machine learning models and user-centric web interfaces.

## Skills & Expertise

- **Frontend**: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python, REST APIs, MongoDB, SQL, Oracle APEX
- **AI & Machine Learning**: PyTorch, YOLO, NLP, LLMs, Computer Vision, Vector Search
- **Cloud**: Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Vercel

## Projects

- **Retail Management Platform**: Full-stack supermarket inventory and POS system (React + Node.js + MongoDB)
- **Healix Doctor Appointment System**: Telehealth platform connecting patients and doctors

- **ResumeIQ Analyzer**: AI-powered resume parsing and ATS scoring tool
- **Fake News Prediction**: ML classifier using NLP for news authenticity detection
- **Voice Analyzer**: Deep learning speech emotion and tone analysis platform
- **House Design Platform**: Interactive 3D house design with drag-and-drop customization
